scope_note: Classification-only proposal. Raw observation identity, pricing, quantity, promotion, and source evidence remain authoritative in the pending source file.

conflict_checks.repository_search_note: All five source_record_key values were checked against the existing explicit review decisions with no match. Current taxonomy has fresh potato, potato snack, and generic raw/prepped frozen-vegetable leaves, but no exact leaf for ready-to-cook frozen fries/wedges. Repository search found no existing frozen-potato candidate precedent.

held_decisions.reason: Explicit frozen fry-cut potato product is more processed than raw/prepped frozen vegetables and is not a shelf-stable potato snack.
Crinkle-cut frozen potato is a ready-to-cook frozen potato side; cut style is an attribute rather than a separate leaf.
The audited frozen-potato shelf plus crinkle-cut product form supports a prepared frozen-potato candidate, not fresh potato or chips.
Cajun seasoning is a flavor treatment on the same frozen potato side product form.
Spiced wedges are the same ready-to-cook frozen potato family; wedge shape and seasoning remain attributes.
